android.desc: Design your own custom widgets—or transform your homescreen in 1 tap with 50+ built-in templates and curated OTA Skin Packs & HD Wallpapers! UCCW (Ultimate Custom Widget) is a powerful WYSIWYG widget maker, skin pack gallery, and charging StandBy display for Android. Build everything from clean minimalist clocks and Material You dashboards to dot-matrix cards, 3D flip clocks, fitness rings, and live media players. 📦 Curated Skin Packs & Matching Wallpapers Browse online widget collections—including Dot Matrix OS, Cyberpunk Neon HUD, Retro Tactile & Bauhaus, Obsidian & Gold, and seasonal packs—complete with matching full-screen HD wallpapers and 1-tap installation. ✨ 50+ Built-in Templates Ready to Use Pick from categorized templates including Material (with Material You dynamic wallpaper colors), Squircle & Glass, Modern UI, Dot Matrix, Flip Clock, Rings & Dial, Editorial, Live Tiles, Retro, and Classic—or import and share .uzip skin files. 🌙 UCCW StandBy Mode (Screen Saver) Turn your phone or tablet into a full-screen bedside or desk display while charging or docked: • Swipe horizontally between your favorite UCCW widgets • Optional Night Red Tint and Dim Display for dark rooms • Automatic pixel-shift burn-in protection for OLED screens 🎨 Powerful WYSIWYG Widget Editor • Smooth Canvas Controls: 2-finger pan & pinch-to-zoom (up to 4×), corner resize handles, live wallpaper preview, and full Undo / Redo history. • Cross-Skin Copy & Format Painter: Copy and paste multiple objects or transfer visual styles (colors, gradients, fonts, shadows) across different skins. • Instant Widget Reassignment: Swap skins on your existing homescreen widgets anytime without deleting or recreating them. • Rich Typography: Custom fonts, Bold & Italic styles, Curved Text (top/bottom arcs), and Monthly Calendar Grids. • Shapes, Gradients & Blend Modes: Rectangles, rounded cards, ovals, triangles, polygons (3–12 sides), linear/radial/sweep gradients, PorterDuff blend modes, and Material You dynamic colors. • Smart Images: Custom photos, Live Album Art (Now Playing), built-in Vector Icons, installed App Icons, and Web Image URLs with fixed Width × Height framing and rounded corners. • Conditional
